A FEW FIRST ANSWERS

Before
hello.

Do I need a finished brief before getting in touch?+

No. A location, an approximate plot size and a sense of what you want to create are enough to begin shaping a conversation.

Can I enquire about a project outside Lahore?+

Include the project location in your brief. Availability, travel and the appropriate project scope would need to be agreed with the studio.

Does this form send my enquiry?+

Not yet. This is a demonstration of the enquiry experience. It prepares a brief in your browser that you can download. No message is sent, no appointment is booked, and no response is scheduled.
